project.name: Todo API
project.goal: Build a simple FastAPI Todo application with SQLite. Implement CRUD operations for todos, Pydantic validation, proper HTTP status codes, and automated pytest tests.

tasks.description: Project Initialization and Data Model Design: Set up the Python project environment, install FastAPI and other dependencies, establish basic project structure, and design the Pydantic 'Todo' model and corresponding SQLite table schema.

Database Connection and Basic CRUD (Create/Read): Implement the SQLite database connection logic and develop API endpoints for creating new todos (POST /todos) and retrieving all todos (GET /todos), ensuring Pydantic validation and appropriate HTTP status codes.

Advanced CRUD (Read by ID, Update, Delete): Develop API endpoints for retrieving a specific todo by ID (GET /todos/{id}), updating an existing todo (PUT /todos/{id}), and deleting a todo (DELETE /todos/{id}), including error handling for not found scenarios and proper status codes.

Error Handling and Edge Case Implementation: Refine error handling for various scenarios, such as invalid input data, non-existent resources, and database errors, ensuring the API returns meaningful error messages and correct HTTP status codes.
Automated Test Environment Setup: Configure pytest for the project, set up a dedicated test database (e.g., in-memory SQLite), and implement foundational test utilities for API testing.
Comprehensive Automated Test Suite Development: Write a full suite of pytest tests covering all CRUD operations, input validation, success cases, and expected error scenarios for each API endpoint.
Execute Tests and Identify Failures: Run the complete suite of automated tests using pytest and systematically analyze the test results to identify any failing tests or unexpected behavior.

Bug Fixing and Code Refinement: Debug and implement necessary code corrections for any identified test failures or bugs. Refine the API implementation to ensure robustness and adherence to specifications, then re-run tests to confirm fixes.

Final API Review and Validation: Conduct a comprehensive review of the entire Todo API to ensure all features work correctly, requirements are met, code quality is maintained, and manual verification confirms full functionality.
